name: Fault Lab
description: Deliberately misbehaves so you can watch the sandbox contain it: an endless loop, a memory bomb and a crash. Safe to install.
author: DiZero

commands.name: hang
commands.description: Run an infinite loop (stopped by the time budget)

commands.name: bomb
commands.description: Allocate until the memory cap is hit

commands.name: escape
commands.description: Probe the sandbox for filesystem, network and process access
